sources.entry: Lowdefy - Build internal tools, BI dashboards, admin panels, CRUD apps and workflows in minutes using YAML / JSON. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Lowdefy is a config-first web framework where internal tools, dashboards, admin panels and CRUD apps are defined in YAML or JSON instead of hand-written React code.
summary.what_it_does: Lowdefy lets you describe a web app as a config file (lowdefy.yaml) with pages, UI blocks, logic operators, event actions and data connections. The README says the runtime is built on Hono and Vite with Auth.js and can be deployed anywhere Node.js runs. It lists 70+ UI components (forms, tables, charts, markdown), 50+ logic operators such as _if, _get, _js and _state, and 10+ data connectors including MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, REST APIs, Google Sheets, S3, Elasticsearch and Stripe. Auth and role-based access control are included, with 75+ auth providers and public or private pages. Blocks, connections, operators, actions, auth providers and adapters can be extended through npm plugins. The project states config is schema-validated and interpreted rather than executed.
use_cases: connect a web UI to databases and REST APIs
add role-based login to an internal app
how_to_run: npx lowdefy@latest init && npx lowdefy@latest dev
notable: Entire app defined in YAML or JSON config rather than custom React components
Config is schema-validated and interpreted, not executed, per the README
Plugin system for custom blocks, connections, operators, actions and auth providers
Built-in auth and RBAC with 75+ auth providers
Tree-shaking bundles only the components an app uses
caveats: The README lists a managed-hosting and consulting offering from Resonancy, the maintainer; no pricing or tier details are given
Migrating from v3 requires following a separate v4 migration guide
